item.title: Prodcat vs. Manual Markdown: A Time Audit
item.description: We ran a time audit comparing a manual Markdown documentation workflow to Prodcat’s automated approach. The results were eye-opening, revealing not just significant time savings but also profound qualitative benefits.
item.content:encoded:
We ran a time audit comparing a manual Markdown documentation workflow to Prodcat’s automated approach. The results were eye-opening, revealing not just significant time savings but also profound qualitative benefits.

The Experiment: A Head-to-Head Comparison​

To quantify the difference, we set up a controlled experiment. The goal was to create a complete documentation site for a catalog of 20 products, each with its own set of features, variants, and specifications.

Team A (Manual Markdown): This team was tasked with creating the site by hand. This involved writing 20 individual Markdown files for the products, creating and updating category pages, and manually managing all internal linking.

Team B (Prodcat): This team was given the same product data, but in the form of a single products.js file. Their task was to use Prodcat to generate the entire site.

The Quantitative Results: A 90% Time Reduction​

The time-tracking data revealed a stark difference in efficiency.

TaskManual MarkdownProdcat
Initial Product Page Creation6 hours45 minutes
Category Linking & Navigation2 hoursAutomatic (0 min)
Fixing Broken Links1 hourAutomatic (0 min)
Updating Shared Metadata1.5 hours10 minutes
Total Time10.5 hours~1 hour

The result is a 90% reduction in the time and effort required to launch a complete product documentation site. The time saved is not just a one-off benefit; it compounds with every new product added and every update made.

Beyond the Numbers: The Qualitative Benefits​

The audit revealed that the true cost of manual documentation isn't just in the hours spent, but also in the quality and consistency of the final product.

  • Guaranteed Consistency: With Prodcat, every product page is generated from the same template. This ensures a uniform structure, layout, and style across the entire site—a feat that is nearly impossible to achieve manually without rigorous, time-consuming reviews.
  • Effortless Maintenance: Need to add a new specification to all products? With a manual approach, that's 20 files to edit. With Prodcat, it's a single change in one template. This drastically reduces the long-term maintenance burden.
  • Built-in SEO and Metadata: Prodcat automatically generates SEO-friendly URLs and metadata from the product data. This foundational SEO work is often overlooked in manual processes but is critical for discoverability.
  • Faster Contributor Onboarding: New team members don't need to learn a complex file structure or a long list of formatting rules. They only need to learn how to add a product object to a JavaScript file, dramatically lowering the barrier to contribution.

Is Manual Markdown Ever the Right Choice?​

For a single, standalone document, Markdown is an excellent tool. But for a collection of structured documents like a product catalog, its limitations become a significant liability. The risk of inconsistency, broken links, and maintenance overhead grows exponentially with each new page.

Conclusion: Upgrade Your Workflow​

If you’re still managing a product documentation site by writing Markdown by hand, this audit demonstrates that there is a more efficient, reliable, and scalable way. Prodcat isn’t just faster — it’s a smarter workflow that delivers a higher-quality result with a fraction of the effort.

item.title: How to Structure Your Product List for Maximum Flexibility
item.description: Your products.js file is the heart of your Prodcat site. A well-structured product list is essential for creating a documentation site that is clear, scalable, and easy to customize. This guide will walk you through best practices for structuring your products.js file to unlock the full potential of Prodcat.
item.content:encoded:
Your products.js file is the heart of your Prodcat site. A well-structured product list is essential for creating a documentation site that is clear, scalable, and easy to customize. This guide will walk you through best practices for structuring your products.js file to unlock the full potential of Prodcat.

Why a Well-Structured products.js Matters​

Prodcat reads your product list and generates documentation automatically. The way you structure this list directly impacts the quality and usability of your generated site. A well-designed schema makes your site:

  • Easier to Navigate: Clear categorization and consistent data allow Prodcat to build intuitive navigation menus and directory pages.
  • More Customizable: A structured approach makes it simpler to apply custom templates and styling, ensuring your documentation aligns with your brand.
  • Scalable: As your product line grows, a consistent structure prevents your documentation from becoming a tangled mess.
  • Easier to Maintain: When all product information is logically organized, updates and additions become straightforward and less error-prone.

Core Product Fields Explained​

Let's break down the recommended structure for a single product entry. Each field serves a specific purpose in generating your documentation.

export default [
  {
    id: "widget-pro",
    name: "Widget Pro",
    description: "A high-performance widget designed for professional use cases, offering unparalleled speed and reliability.",
    category: "Widgets",
    price: 199.99,
    features: [
      "Blazing-fast performance",
      "Enterprise-grade reliability",
      "Lightweight and efficient design"
    ],
    variants: [
      { name: "Standard", sku: "WP-STD" },
      { name: "Deluxe", sku: "WP-DLX" }
    ],
  },
];
  • id (String, Required): A unique identifier for the product. This is used to generate file names and URLs, so it should be a URL-friendly string (e.g., widget-pro, advanced-gadget-v2).
  • name (String, Required): The official name of the product. This will be used as the main heading on the product page.
  • description (String, Required): A detailed description of the product. This is your opportunity to provide a comprehensive overview. You can use Markdown here for formatting.
  • category (String): The primary category the product belongs to. Prodcat uses this to group products and create category-specific pages.

Leveraging Categories for Better Navigation​

The category field is fundamental to organizing your site. By assigning categories consistently, you enable users to easily browse related products. For example, a products.js file with multiple products might look like this:

export default [
  { id: "widget-pro", name: "Widget Pro", category: "Widgets", ... },
  { id: "widget-basic", name: "Widget Basic", category: "Widgets", ... },
  { id: "gadget-plus", name: "Gadget Plus", category: "Gadgets", ... },
];

Prodcat will automatically generate a "Widgets" page listing both "Widget Pro" and "Widget Basic," and a separate "Gadgets" page for "Gadget Plus."

Using Features to Highlight Key Selling Points​

The features array is perfect for showcasing the key benefits of your product. Each string in the array will be rendered as a list item, making it easy for customers to scan.

features: [
  "Feature A: Solves a common problem",
  "Feature B: Improves efficiency",
  "Feature C: Integrates with other tools"
],

Use this section to be concise and impactful.

Managing Product Variants Effectively​

For products that come in different versions (e.g., sizes, colors, or feature tiers), the variants array is indispensable. Each object in the array represents a unique variant.

variants: [
  { name: "Standard", sku: "WP-STD", price: 199.99 },
  { name: "Deluxe", sku: "WP-DLX", price: 299.99, features: ["Additional premium feature"] }
],

You can even include a price or additional features within a variant object to override the main product's properties. This provides a high degree of flexibility.

By following these structuring guidelines, you can ensure that your products.js file is a robust foundation for a high-quality, maintainable, and scalable product documentation site.

item.title: Why We Built Prodcat: From Chaos to Clarity
item.description: Maintaining product documentation was eating our time and sanity. We built Prodcat to fix that — and here’s how it changed everything. It’s the story of moving from a state of constant, low-grade chaos to one of structure and clarity.
item.content:encoded:
Maintaining product documentation was eating our time and sanity. We built Prodcat to fix that — and here’s how it changed everything. It’s the story of moving from a state of constant, low-grade chaos to one of structure and clarity.

The Breaking Point: A Cascade of Small Problems​

Before Prodcat, our documentation process was a fragile system held together by manual effort and wishful thinking. We were juggling dozens of Markdown files across multiple product lines. The workflow was not just inefficient; it was a constant source of errors.

  • Inconsistent Information: A price update meant hunting down every instance of that price across multiple files. A changed feature name could linger in old documents for months.
  • Broken Navigation: Every new product required manually adding links to category pages and navigation bars. It was tedious and incredibly easy to miss a link or create a broken one.
  • Onboarding Nightmare: Bringing a new team member up to speed was a challenge. There was no single source of truth, just a collection of files with their own quirks and histories.
  • Slow to Scale: Launching a new product or a new product line was a monumental task that involved more copy-pasting than innovation.

The collective weight of these "small" problems was immense. It was death by a thousand paper cuts.

The 'Aha!' Moment: Documentation as Data​

The turning point came when we stopped thinking about our documentation as a collection of static pages and started thinking about it as data. Our products had names, descriptions, prices, and features. This was structured information, so why were we managing it in an unstructured way?

We asked ourselves: What if our documentation could be generated from a single, canonical source of truth?

This simple question was the genesis of Prodcat. We envisioned a tool that would take a simple JavaScript array of product objects and handle the rest. No more Markdown files to wrangle. No more broken links to fix. Just clean, consistent, and automatically generated documentation.

Our Core Principles in Building Prodcat​

That vision evolved into a philosophy that guided Prodcat's development. We built it around three core principles:

  1. Centralize Your Data: There should only be one place to update product information. The products.js file became our single source of truth. Change a product's name there, and it changes everywhere on the site.
  2. Automate the Boring Parts: Manual, repetitive tasks are a recipe for errors and burnout. Prodcat was designed to automate the entire process of creating product pages, directory pages, and navigation.
  3. Focus on What Matters — Your Products: Developers and product managers should spend their time building and improving products, not wrestling with documentation tools. Prodcat frees them to do just that.

The Transformation: From Chaos to Clarity​

Implementing Prodcat internally was transformative. The chaos of managing dozens of individual files was replaced by the clarity of a single, well-structured data source.

  • Updates became trivial. A feature change now requires editing a single line in one file.
  • Consistency is now guaranteed. Every product page follows the same template, ensuring a uniform and professional user experience.
  • Scaling is now effortless. Adding a new product is as simple as adding a new object to an array.

Whether you’re documenting hardware, software, or services, Prodcat is designed to help you scale your documentation without sacrificing clarity or your team's sanity. It's the tool we wish we'd had from the start.

item.title: Getting Started with Prodcat: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Welcome to the Prodcat blog! In this article, we'll walk you through the basics of getting started with Prodcat. Whether you're a small business owner, a developer, or just someone who wants to create a beautiful product documentation website, Prodcat is the tool for you.
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to the Prodcat blog! In this article, we'll walk you through the basics of getting started with Prodcat. Whether you're a small business owner, a developer, or just someone who wants to create a beautiful product documentation website, Prodcat is the tool for you.

What is Prodcat?​

Prodcat is a powerful tool that allows you to generate a professional product documentation website from a simple list of products. With Prodcat, you can create a beautiful, feature-rich website in minutes, without any prior experience in web development.

Step 1: Installation​

The first step is to install Prodcat. You can do this by running the following command in your terminal:

npm install -g prodcat

This will install Prodcat globally on your system, so you can use it from anywhere.

Step 2: Initialization​

Once you have Prodcat installed, you can create a new project by running the prodcat init command. This will create a new directory with the basic project structure.

prodcat init my-product-site

This will create a new directory called my-product-site with all the necessary files to get started.

Step 3: Add Your Products​

The next step is to add your products to the products.js file. This file is located in the root of your project directory, and it's where you'll define all of your products. Here's an example of what a product object looks like:

{
  id: 'prod1',
  name: 'Sample Product',
  description: 'This is a sample product.',
  price: '$99.99',
  features: ['Feature 1', 'Feature 2'],
  specifications: [
    { key: 'Weight', value: '1kg' },
    { key: 'Dimensions', value: '10x10x10 cm' }
  ],
  images: ['/img/prod1.jpg']
}

Step 4: Generate Your Website​

Once you've added your products, you can generate your website by running the prodcat generate command.

prodcat generate

This will generate a static HTML website in the website/build directory.

Step 5: View Your Website​

That's it! You can now view your website by opening the website/build/index.html file in your browser. Or, you can run npm start in the website directory to start a local development server.

We hope this guide has been helpful. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on GitHub.

item.title: Why Your Business Needs a Product Documentation Website
item.description: In today's digital age, having an online presence is crucial for any business. But what about a product documentation website? Is it really necessary? In this article, we'll explore why your business needs a product documentation website and how it can benefit you.
item.content:encoded:
In today's digital age, having an online presence is crucial for any business. But what about a product documentation website? Is it really necessary? In this article, we'll explore why your business needs a product documentation website and how it can benefit you.

1. Improved Customer Experience​

A well-structured product documentation website can significantly improve the customer experience. It provides your customers with a single source of truth for all your products, making it easy for them to find the information they need. This can lead to increased customer satisfaction and loyalty.

2. Reduced Support Costs​

A comprehensive product documentation website can also help you reduce support costs. By providing your customers with the information they need to solve their own problems, you can reduce the number of support tickets and phone calls your team has to handle. This can free up your support team to focus on more complex issues.

3. Increased Sales​

A product documentation website can also help you increase sales. By providing potential customers with detailed information about your products, you can help them make an informed purchasing decision. This can lead to increased conversion rates and more sales for your business.

4. Improved SEO​

A product documentation website can also help you improve your search engine optimization (SEO). By creating high-quality, keyword-rich content, you can attract more organic traffic to your website. This can lead to increased brand awareness and more potential customers.

5. A Professional Image​

Finally, a product documentation website can help you project a professional image to your customers. A well-designed, easy-to-use website shows that you're a serious business that cares about its customers. This can help you build trust and credibility with your audience.

In conclusion, a product documentation website is a valuable asset for any business. It can help you improve the customer experience, reduce support costs, increase sales, improve your SEO, and project a professional image. And with a tool like Prodcat, creating a product documentation website has never been easier.

item.title: The Power of Automation: How Prodcat Saves You Time
item.description: In today's fast-paced world, time is a precious commodity. That's why automation is so important. In this article, we'll explore how Prodcat uses automation to save you time and effort when creating a product documentation website.
item.content:encoded:
In today's fast-paced world, time is a precious commodity. That's why automation is so important. In this article, we'll explore how Prodcat uses automation to save you time and effort when creating a product documentation website.

Manual vs. Automated​

Traditionally, creating a website has been a manual and time-consuming process. You had to write the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and then you had to manually create a page for each of your products. This could take days, or even weeks, depending on the number of products you have.

With Prodcat, the entire process is automated. You simply add your products to a products.js file, and Prodcat does the rest. It automatically generates a page for each of your products, as well as a main landing page and a categories page.

How it Works​

Prodcat uses a combination of technologies to automate the process of creating a website. It uses Node.js to read your products.js file, and then it uses Handlebars to generate Markdown files for each of your products. Finally, it uses Docusaurus to generate a static HTML website from the Markdown files.

The entire process is seamless and transparent. You don't need to know anything about Node.js, Handlebars, or Docusaurus to use Prodcat. You just need to know how to add your products to the products.js file.

The Benefits of Automation​

The benefits of automation are clear. By automating the process of creating a website, Prodcat can save you a significant amount of time and effort. This allows you to focus on what you do best: creating great products.

But the benefits of automation go beyond time savings. By automating the process, Prodcat also ensures that your website is consistent and professional. You don't have to worry about making a mistake or forgetting to update a page. Prodcat takes care of all the details for you.

Conclusion​

In conclusion, Prodcat is a powerful tool that uses automation to save you time and effort when creating a product documentation website. It's the perfect solution for businesses and individuals who want to create a professional-looking website without spending a lot of time and money.

item.title: Customizing Your Prodcat Website: A Deep Dive
item.description: One of the great things about Prodcat is that it's highly customizable. In this article, we'll take a deep dive into the different ways you can customize your Prodcat website to match your brand and meet your needs.
item.content:encoded:
One of the great things about Prodcat is that it's highly customizable. In this article, we'll take a deep dive into the different ways you can customize your Prodcat website to match your brand and meet your needs.

Theming​

The easiest way to customize your Prodcat website is by modifying the CSS. Prodcat uses the Infima CSS framework, which is highly customizable. You can change the color palette, typography, and other aspects of the design by modifying the website/src/css/custom.css file.

You can also customize the Docusaurus components by "swizzling" them. Swizzling allows you to replace a theme component with your own implementation. This is a powerful feature that gives you full control over the markup and logic of the components.

Templates​

Prodcat uses Handlebars to generate the Markdown files for your product pages and directories. The templates are located in the templates directory of your Prodcat project. You can modify these templates to change the structure and content of the generated Markdown files.

For example, you could add new sections to the product pages or change the layout of the product directory. The templates are written in Handlebars, which is a simple and powerful templating language.

Configuration​

Prodcat has two main configuration files: prodcat.config.js and website/docusaurus.config.js. These files allow you to customize various aspects of your website, such as the site's title, logo, navbar, and footer.

You can also use these files to configure more advanced features, such as search integration and internationalization.

Plugins​

Finally, you can extend the functionality of Prodcat by creating your own plugins. The plugin system allows you to add new commands to the CLI, modify the build process, or integrate with other tools and services.

This is an advanced feature that requires some knowledge of Node.js and the Prodcat codebase. But it's a powerful way to extend the functionality of Prodcat and tailor it to your specific needs.

Conclusion​

In conclusion, Prodcat is a highly customizable tool that allows you to create a product documentation website that's a perfect fit for your brand. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, you'll find plenty of ways to customize your Prodcat website and make it your own.

item.title: Prodcat vs. The World: Why Prodcat is the Best Choice for Product Documentation
item.description: There are a lot of tools out there for creating documentation websites. So why should you choose Prodcat? In this article, we'll compare Prodcat to some of the other popular options and explain why we think Prodcat is the best choice for product documentation.
item.content:encoded:
There are a lot of tools out there for creating documentation websites. So why should you choose Prodcat? In this article, we'll compare Prodcat to some of the other popular options and explain why we think Prodcat is the best choice for product documentation.

Prodcat vs. WordPress​

WordPress is a popular choice for creating websites, but it's not the best choice for product documentation. WordPress is a general-purpose CMS, which means it's not optimized for documentation. It can be difficult to create a well-structured documentation website with WordPress, and it can be even more difficult to maintain it over time.

Prodcat, on the other hand, is specifically designed for product documentation. It's easy to create a well-structured website with Prodcat, and it's even easier to maintain it.

Prodcat vs. Read the Docs​

Read the Docs is a popular platform for hosting documentation, but it's not a documentation generator. You still have to write the documentation yourself, and then you have to upload it to Read the Docs.

With Prodcat, the entire process is automated. You simply add your products to a products.js file, and Prodcat does the rest. It automatically generates a beautiful, feature-rich website for you.

Prodcat vs. Docusaurus​

Prodcat is built on top of Docusaurus, which is a popular static site generator. But Docusaurus is a general-purpose tool, which means it's not optimized for product documentation. You still have to do a lot of work to create a product documentation website with Docusaurus.

Prodcat takes care of all the heavy lifting for you. It provides you with a pre-configured Docusaurus project that's optimized for product documentation. It also provides you with a set of Handlebars templates that you can use to generate your product pages.

Conclusion​

In conclusion, there are a lot of tools out there for creating documentation websites. But if you're looking for a tool that's specifically designed for product documentation, then Prodcat is the best choice for you. It's easy to use, it's highly customizable, and it's built on top of the best technologies available.
